title: Figure 7: The Invisible Woman – costumed figure, inspiration for cloaking
description: Color photograph of a woman with long blonde hair in a dark blue Fantastic Four costume with a "4" emblem, posed as the comic character the Invisible Woman against a dark background. The caption reads "Figure 7. The Invisible Woman. Invisibility by bending light, an inspiration for cloaking." The text discusses Fermat's principle of the shortest optical path and curved geometry.
